title: Fitness game meets fantasy RPG
author: tr99house123
selftext:
I built a fantasy RPG in which you gain energy to play from burning calories IRL. 

Aside from that, it is a tap to explore kind of game, with minimal stuff blinking and glowing at you to provide exploration as authentic as possible. 

You explore, gather materials, craft, upgrade your base and even tame companions. 

It is unlike Pokemon GO, where you walk around staring at your phone. My game waits for you, walk the dog, go for a run or just walk around live your everyday life, everything counts as long as you have your phone or smart watch on you and when you are ready you delve into the world of Yvernath. 

External testing of first biome is currently live for iOS users. Goal is to validate core gameplay loop.

comments.author: RXLGames
comments.body: Awesome. I’m also building a fitness rpg. I think we came to similar conclusions that we don’t want to force players to play while they exercise, but I do think it’s important that they have the option to do so. Is everything connected via the health app?
